This spacious retreat offers 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and sleeps 14 guests. Just across the street from the beach, enjoy an expansive outdoor area with a private pool, large fire pit, corn hole, outdoor kitchen, and al fresco dining – perfect for memorable gatherings with loved ones, including your furry companions! Inlet Getaway is ideal for large group retreats and family reunions! This beach house is the ultimate getaway spot for those who want to experience the pristine shores of 30A. Conveniently located across the street from the beach, you'll have easy access to the sun, sand, and sea. The expansive backyard is equipped with a private pool, fire pit, corn hole game, outdoor kitchen and dining area, providing everything you need for an unforgettable stay. Inside, the beach house offers four bedrooms and two bathrooms, tastefully appointed with coastal-inspired decor, plush furnishings, and modern amenities, accommodating up to 14 guests. You'll find everything you need to relax and recharge in this spacious and welcoming retreat. Whether you're looking to soak up the sun, take a dip in the pool, roast marshmallows around the fire pit, or enjoy alfresco dining under the stars, this beach house has it all. Don't settle for anything less than the best – book your stay today and experience the ultimate beach vacation! Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: 2 Full over Full Bunks & Jack and Jill Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 2: King Bed & Jack and Jill Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 3: 2 Queen over Queen Bunks, Sleeper Sofa. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 4: King Bed & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo.
